 Highlights Today’s matches schedule, Wednesday 21-10-2026, and the broadcasting channels 
 Egyptian League 
 Champions League 
 Spanish League 
 Football fans will be looking forward to a number of highly anticipated matches in several local and European competitions on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, most notably the Egyptian Al-Ahly vs. Al-Qanah match in the Egyptian League, and the Real Madrid vs. RB Leipzig match in the Champions League.
 The Egyptian league competitions will witness 3 matches, as Ghazl El Mahalla will meet Al Ittihad Alexandria, Al Ahly will face Al Qanah, and Ceramica Cleopatra will play against Suez Petrojet.
 Al-Ahly enters its match against Al-Qanah with the ambition to continue its positive results, after achieving victory over its rival Zamalek in the last round, seeking to strengthen its journey in the competition.
 On the European level, the Bayern Munich vs. Arsenal match tops the list of the most prominent matches of the day, along with the Real Madrid vs. Leipzig match, the Inter Milan vs. Shakhtar Donetsk match, as well as the matches that bring together Como and Manchester United, Aston Villa and Viking, Real Betis and Feyenoord Rotterdam, and Lille and Galatasaray.
 The Spanish league also features a match between Levante and Athletic Bilbao, as part of today’s games.
 Today’s matches schedule, Wednesday 21-10-2026, and the broadcasting channels
 Egyptian League
 Ghazl El Mahalla vs Al Ittihad Alexandria: 6:00 PM UAE time, 5:00 PM Egypt and Saudi Arabia time, on “On Sport Plus” channel.
 Al Ahly vs Al Qanah: 9:00 PM UAE time, 8:00 PM Egypt and Saudi Arabia time, via “On Sport” channel.
 Ceramica Cleopatra vs Suez Petrojet: 9:00 PM UAE time, 8:00 PM Egypt and Saudi Arabia time, on “On Sport Max” channel.
 Champions League
 Como vs Manchester United: 8:45 PM UAE time, 7:45 PM Egypt and Saudi Arabia time, via “beIN Sports 2” channel.
 Lille vs Galatasaray: 8:45 PM UAE time, 7:45 PM Egypt and Saudi Arabia time, via “beIN Sports 3” channel.
 Aston Villa vs Viking: 11:00 PM UAE time, 10:00 PM Egypt and Saudi Arabia time, via “beIN Sports 4” channel.
 Bayern Munich vs Arsenal: 11:00 PM UAE time, 10:00 PM Egypt and Saudi Arabia time, via “beIN Sports 1” channel.
 Real Betis vs Feyenoord Rotterdam: 11:00 PM UAE time, 10:00 PM Egypt and Saudi Arabia time, via “beIN Sports 5” channel.
 Real Madrid vs RB Leipzig: 11:00 PM UAE time, 10:00 PM Egypt and Saudi Arabia time, via “beIN Sports 2” channel.
 Inter Milan vs Shakhtar Donetsk: 11:00 PM UAE time, 10:00 PM Egypt and Saudi Arabia time, via “beIN Sports 3” channel.
 Spanish League
 Levante vs Athletic Bilbao: 11:00 PM UAE time, 10:00 PM Egypt and Saudi Arabia time, via “beIN Sports XTRA 1” channel.
